comparison.legacy_function_difference: E075 retains the original score-ranked combination order and objective/tie-break semantics, while returning the score-order tuple and candidate pool as additional audit diagnostics. Its selected sorted ticket remains the original return value.
comparison.bug_confirmed_in_both_frozen_e045_source: The consecutive-pair count and lexicographic tie-break are evaluated on score-ranked combination order, not the sorted ticket specified by preregistration.
